answer: An attacker must as a result build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the ocean settlement applies the void retroactively. The anchor edge is logged both ways, so a closed ring of 66 clones produces a signature the kernel analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
